title: Indian Fusion Paratha Pasta & Potato-Paneer Ravioli
instructions: Prep & mise en place: Gather and prepare all components for Indian Fusion Paratha Pasta & Potato-Paneer Ravioli.
Noodles from parantha dough with a Indian cream sauce and fried paneer and lines of sour cream and green sauce
Season to taste with kosher salt, freshly cracked black pepper, and finishing garnishes before serving warm.
notes: Original Doc Shorthand: Stuffed raviolis with potato and paneer — Noodles from parantha dough with a Indian cream sauce and fried paneer and lines of sour cream and green sauce
